title: With Nicolas Maduro in a New York prison, who will govern Venezuela now?
summary: With Nicolas Maduro in a New York prison, his vice-president Delcy Rodriguez has been sworn in as president. And while Donald Trump announced his intention to "run Venezuela" on Saturday, she used her inaugural address to say "never again will we be a colony"... So what does Venezuela's immediate political future hold? Story by Charlotte Hughes and Antonia…
